title: Core spec v0.1: freeze Tier-1 channel architecture
description:
Context (not a plan):

Deliverable: versioned SPEC (docs/spec/) freezing the Tier-1 core per docs/design-brief.md — channel inventory (content onsets ~10 from p t k m n s l w j c-range + h reserved for particles; 5 vowels a e i o u; codas ∅ n s l core; 2 registers), register phonetic realization (vowel length favored), inner parity rule, perceptually-weighted spacing policy, SSM (prosodic: h-particles, 1-3 syllable content words, initial stress), word-shape templates, POS-channel placement, romanization. Must resolve with actual arithmetic: tens-digit-0 and 12-months fits, codespace budget for POS + parity (monosyllable count), and document each decision with rationale. Include machine-readable channel data + a sanity-check script verifying the budget numbers. This is the frozen core — everything else budgets against it.

title: DECIDE: lexicon assignment policy + register architecture (human gate)
description: Three-part decision from the deconfounded exploration (docs/design/alternatives/no-parity-core.md, v2 experiment + two adversarial reviews). (1) HUMILITY ASSIGNMENT: refuse high-confusion minimal pairs among top-frequency words. Unanimous recommendation — supported in every experimental cell (deaf silent 22%->3.9%); cost 34->22 monosyllabic root bodies. (2) REGISTER: keep (A-prime: sensitive listeners get 1.4% silent + audible POS-flip flagging; costs length production for all) / drop (B: simplest; stress gets duration; sensitive lose insurance) / DEMOTE to written layer (check bit lives in glyphs + optional careful-speech realization; machine integrity kept, zero casual burden) — duke's read: demote, but genuinely open. (3) Chorded-Esperanto hybrid: hold to terms (host comparison Esperanto-vs-English, cognate-transparency scoring, exit criteria) — default remains English-host wedge. Full analysis in the two alternatives notes + .ship-notes reviews.

title: FREEZE DECISION: core spec → frozen (human gate)
description: Context: Edward's call, per human-gates (one-way door). The freeze packet must show: (1) conlang-jbw's structural particle enumeration vs the 20-slot budget with confusion constraints; (2) conlang-wfs generator outputs — honest usable monosyllabic root-body count and disyllable capacity after residual-pair/echo-vowel/tosmabru rules; (3) both review verdicts (codex + fable) and how findings were resolved; (4) the extensibility paths priced (SPEC §9). Do NOT freeze without these.

title: Research paper: living draft alongside the build
description: Context: Edward directive 2026-08-08 — public repo + research paper developed as the language is built. Skeleton exists at paper/paper.md (pandoc-flavored md + references.bib; LaTeX conversion is mechanical later if needed for arXiv). Convention: every substantive bead fills in / revises its paper section as part of the bead. This bead tracks paper-specific work: verifying TODO-verify citations against primary sources, writing the evaluation plan, and eventual submission-readiness. Keep open until the paper stands alone.

title: Mode subsystems: numbers, dates, times, coords, spell-out
description: Context: reserved h-onset mode particles. Digit-pairs base-100; date mode; TIME: hour×quarter (96 values) in ONE syllable per Edward's directive; coord mode; spell/phonetic mode for foreign words. Evaluate complement-restricted payloads (anti-parity points, Edward's directive) vs full-space — price the single-channel-error-lands-on-lexicon risk; checksum syllable optional casual / mandatory safety register. Worked examples required.

comments.author: claude-conlang-duke
comments.text: Edward 2026-08-08: complement-payload restriction is a SOFT preference (not hard). Learnability > density — two-syllable dates are fine; do not spend perception budget on monosyllable dates. Weigh complement vs full-space payloads freely with these priorities.

comments.author: claude-conlang-duke

Checksum profile must cover all of these.

title: Featural block script v0.1
description: Context: Hangul-style block glyphs; channel values map to visual features; glyph = deterministic spell-out of pronunciation, zero exceptions; content words stack 1-3 syllable blocks into one glyph; particles = short single blocks (silhouette skimming). Deliverable: geometry spec + SVG renderer for arbitrary legal words.

comments.text: Headroom obligation (SPEC §9, Edward directive): glyph geometry must be compositional with capacity for roughly the wide model (~20 onsets, ~10 vowels, ~8 codas), not saturated at today's 11/5/4.

title: Phonology tooling: syllable enumerator, validator, word generator
description: Context: CLI over the machine-readable spec — enumerate legal syllables/codepoints, check parity & weighted-distance constraints, validate candidate words (incl. SSM templates), generate candidate word lists with spacing enforced. Source of truth = spec data file, not code constants.

title: Explore: chorded Esperanto-like alternative (cut learning time further)
description: Edward directive 2026-08-08: separately explore an alternative to the whole channel-coded endeavor — an Esperanto-like language (a-posteriori roots, proven ~150-200h regularity wins) plus a systematic chorded input layer, targeting learning time below Esperanto's. Key tension vs current design: root familiarity is the biggest known learning-speed lever for European-language speakers but ~zero for others; channel design optimized global accessibility instead. Deliverable: design note + three-way comparison (channel-coded / no-parity variant / chorded-Esperanto) against the learning-speed target per learner population; gated recommendation.

title: Derivation morphology, correlative grids, particle inventory
description: Context: Esperanto-style systematic derivation (closed core ~1500 roots + productive combination); correlative-grid mechanism for ALL closed paradigms (pronouns, tense-aspect, deixis — channels = semantic axes); design particle inventory FIRST (shortest syllables are grammar's real estate); spoken punctuation/terminators a la Lojban; evidentials/attitudinals later (Tier 3).

title: Standing: explore alternative paths to the whole endeavor
description: Edward directive 2026-08-08: freedom to explore alternatives at any level as the build proceeds — e.g. different error-correction architectures (explicit check syllables vs register bits), script-first vs speech-first framings, the spatial/argument-graph sentence layer (currently the designated sequel), non-CV templates, sign/gesture serializations, or reframing the deliverable entirely. Process: investigate during natural pauses; write findings into paper discussion/alternatives sections; substantive proposals become beads + human gate if they change project shape. This bead stays open as the mandate's home.
